inputs.style: Ferocious old-school Brazilian death thrash metal, razor-picked distorted guitar riffs, harsh aggressive intelligible male English vocals, explosive double-kick drums, raw tight bass. 196 BPM, E minor. fast tremolo riff with abrupt syncopated rests; dissonant solo and a punishing half-time breakdown. Raw heavily overdriven rhythm guitar amplifiers, forceful male English vocals. Complete 280-330 second song, extended developed guitar solo, riff variations, final chorus and decisive heavy ending. Extended instrumental development followed by two emphatic final chorus reprises.
inputs.lyrics:
[Verse]
Dust crawls on the tower glass
The flag is cut, the crown is ash
He keeps the dial spinning round
A voice from underground

[Chorus]
Baptized in static
Signal bleeds through the wire
No god to save the flock
Just the hiss and the fire
Baptized in static

[Verse]
They drag the mics through the street
Chasing the ghost on the beat
The regulator is dead
But the frequency is spread

[Chorus]
Baptized in static
Signal bleeds through the wire
No god to save the flock
Just the hiss and the fire
Baptized in static

[Verse]
The tower leans against the night
The generator coughs through dying light
They climb the rusted service door
With hammers swinging, kicking at the floor
One spark ignites the tangled mess
The voice screams out in its final stress
Not a word of power or command
Just a dial tone eating the land
The listeners drop their radios flat
The static wins, the signal’s flat
We are baptized in nothing now
The broadcast dies within the vow

[Bridge]
Half-time thunder shakes the floor
The breaker trips, the lights are sore
One last command in the dark
They cut the cord, the world is stark

[Solo]
Dissonant scream, razor edge
Chasing the echo, seeking the ledge

[Chorus]
Baptized in static
Signal bleeds through the wire
No god to save the flock
Just the hiss and the fire
Baptized in static

[Chorus]
Baptized in static
Signal bleeds through the wire
No god to save the flock
Just the hiss and the fire
Baptized in static

[Chorus]
Baptized in static
Signal bleeds through the wire
No god to save the flock
Just the hiss and the fire
Baptized in static

[Outro]
Silence falls
The tower cracks
